# Payal Ponkshe

Fintech and payments executive with 18+ years of experience across Mastercard, Wirecard, and DeFi. Independent AI venture builder since 2024, with 6 ventures in build or live production. Based in Germany, German citizen, open to Europe and remote engagements.

## About

Payal Ponkshe is a senior fintech and payments executive with 18+ years of experience across Mastercard, Wirecard, DeFi, and regulated financial services. She specialises in agentic transformation, AI operating model design, and enterprise change programmes.

At Mastercard she was VP Global Head Delivery & Operations — leading $25M+ technology partnerships (Microsoft, Verizon) across 4 regions (Europe, North America, Middle East/Africa, Asia-Pacific) with a 120+ person team. She delivered a 30% reduction in development cycles and 200% YoY client engagement growth.

In 2022 she co-founded Skyllfull, a specialised talent platform for DeFi and Web3 clients, generating €250K+ qualified pipeline within 30 days of launch. Since 2024 she has been building AI ventures independently — shipping production systems in n8n, Claude API, Supabase, and MCP integrations that she designed and built herself.

She consults and advises founders, COOs, and operators in fintech, payments, and AI-first companies.

## Services

**Enterprise Transformation & Programme Delivery**
Leading complex, cross-border change programmes in regulated financial services. Programme governance frameworks, operating model design, portfolio management, multi-region delivery leadership, executive stakeholder alignment. Evidence: led Mastercard R&D global operating model transformation — 30% faster development cycles, 35% efficiency gain.

**AI Implementation & Operating Model Design**
Designing and building AI-first operating models that connect to revenue per employee, not just innovation metrics. AI readiness assessment, agentic system architecture, n8n/automation pipeline design, build-vs-buy decision frameworks. Evidence: built 6 AI ventures hands-on — pipelines, multi-agent systems, MCP integrations, production deployments.

**Fractional COO / Strategic Advisory**
Embedded executive support for founders and scale-ups navigating fintech, payments, and AI transformation. Operating model design, OKR and governance frameworks, partner and ecosystem strategy, commercial model design, team structure and hiring advisory.

- https://payalponkshe.com/insights/iso-20022-data-asset-not-compliance-chore — ISO 20022 is not a compliance exercise. It is the most significant data infrastructure upgrade in payments in 20 years.

## AI Ventures

6 AI ventures in build or live production:

**AI Content Intelligence Pipeline (Live)**
End-to-end brand-locked content reconstruction pipeline. Stack: n8n, Claude API, GPT Image, Gemini, Supabase, React Native, Next.js.

**German Language Exam Prep App (Live on Google Play)**
CEFR A1-B1 exam preparation platform with 850+ exam-aligned questions, hybrid AI and deterministic scoring, GDPR by design. Stack: React Native, Expo, Supabase, Claude API, OpenAI Realtime, ElevenLabs, RevenueCat.

**Spaarker: AI Carousel Content Platform (In Build)**
Purpose-built carousel generation platform for content creators. Stack: Next.js, Supabase, OpenAI, Claude Vision, n8n, Stripe.

**AI Workflow Generator HumanlyReal (Prototype)**
Natural language to deployable automation via three-agent architecture. Stack: n8n, OpenAI GPT-4, Supabase, Vercel.

**Wyngs: AI Literacy Platform for Adults 60+ (In Build)**
Contribution-first platform positioning older adults as knowledge contributors. Stack: React Native, Expo, Claude API, n8n.

**Agentic Commerce Venture Studio (Concept)**
EU-specific operating system for agentic commerce, 15 sellable agent offers, 90-day launch checklist. Stack: LangGraph, n8n, pgvector, Hetzner.
